description: Benchmark task (docs/benchmark_rules.md). Three-stage current-starved ring oscillator with signal-flip protection delay cells (paper Fig. 6), gpdk180, 1.8 V, free-running at 15 MHz set by the externally adjustable biases VBP / VBN. Single condition (nominal NN, 27 C, 1.8 V: the paper reports no PVT sweep and no temperature). Load 10 fF on VRO (the paper's output buffers are not in the netlist). Targets are the paper's measured values with 10 % linear tolerance: frequency 15 MHz (two-sided), power 178.9 uW, phase noise -95.43 dBc/Hz at 1 MHz, output swing 0-1.8 V, and the radiation tests: per-cycle frequency deviation after an emulated single-event strike of 0.25 pC within -5 % .. +11 %, and no more than 30 % deviation at 1.3 pC (the paper's critical charge). The strike test (recipe vco_see_v1) injects an exponential current pulse into the three delay-cell output nodes at pseudo-random clock phases (deterministic strike set, see onboarding_status). No Monte Carlo (the paper reports none), no G8 (ring oscillator).

source.title: Um and Lee, 'A Fault-Tolerant Current-Starved Ring Oscillator With Signal-Flip Protection Delay Cells Against Radiation Effects', IEEE TCAS-II 70(3):880-884, Mar 2023
source.figure: Fig. 6 (three-stage current-starved ring with signal-flip protection delay cells SPDC-1..3, VBP/VBN bias, output VRO); test setup Fig. 7 (built-in SEE emulator injecting an exponential current ISEE into each SPDC output node)
